$comment: THE CONTENT QUEUE (#446, §2.3 of SEO-AGENT-SETUP.md). Durable state in the
repo — never in a conversation, never in a scratchpad. #293 is the standing
worked example of why: an SEO thread reported two real findings into a session
transcript and nothing on this surface can read one back, so they are gone.
HOW THIS SECTION IS DIFFERENT FROM THE BRIEF'S ASSUMPTIONS, and it changes the
shape of every item here. /resources/ is defined as ONE ARTICLE PER LEARNING
(#159): data/learnings.json is the ledger, test/learnings.test.js enforces it
in both directions, and an article declaring no learning fails npm test. A
queue commissioned against a KEYWORD therefore cannot just be written — each
item names the ledger row it will carry, and that row has to be a real finding
The ledger's own scope note is what makes this legitimate rather than a
workaround. It covers Parts 1, 3, 5, 8 and 9, and says of the rest: 'Promote a
row out of them the day one turns out to be — the rule is the reader, not the
part number.' Part 7 (the AI era) turns out to hold exactly the material the
operator's tools ask needs, so items below promote rows out of it.
STATUS values: queued | writing | published. An item is only 'published' once
the page answers 200 on prospektor.ai — rule 5 of the thread protocol.

cluster.name: founder-led sales
cluster.verbatim_ask: First series I want to opitmize for, is a series of articles on 'founder led sales' and how modern user friendly sales tools, can help the founder
cluster.shape: pillar + spokes. The pillar is an EXISTING article promoted, not a new URL.
shape_decided_by: The operator, 31 Aug 2026, choosing 'Promote the existing article' over a new
pillar and over spokes-only. /resources/do-not-delegate-sales/ already holds
the head term in its own description ('Why founder-led sales cannot be
delegated early') and already carries FIVE §8.5 learnings, so it is the
founder-led-sales hub in substance already. A second page aimed at the term
would have been the exact defect `distinct_from` exists to prevent — and
promoting keeps the page's age, its inbound links and its URL, at the cost
of no redirect and no cannibalisation window.
register_decided_by: The operator, 31 Aug 2026, choosing 'Teaching-first, tools generic' over
comparison pages naming rivals. So: no competitor is named, no feature matrix,
no pricing claim about anybody else. This is also the cheap way to stay true —
a claim about a rival's plan is stale the week after it is written, and
docs/seo/project-facts.md bans it unless read off their live page and dated.
cluster.closed_at: Four pieces, 7 Sep 2026: the promoted pillar plus three spokes. Not five — the playbook holds exactly three spoke-sized findings on this term that were not already articles (§7.1, §7.5, §7.6), and a fourth would need a learning that does not exist. A fifth piece is a new queue item the day a learning lands. ROADMAP.md in prospektor-ai/studio, #447, 7 Sep, carries the decision.

queue.title: Why they buy is not who they are
queue.seo_title: Jobs to be done vs buyer personas
queue.primary_keyword: jobs to be done vs personas b2b
queue.angle: Two independent experts, one conclusion: segment by the workflow and the job, not the industry. The correction to persona-first targeting.
queue.distinct_from: niche-down argues narrowing wins MORE customers — a size argument. This is about the AXIS you narrow on, and would be wrong to write as a second niching article. who-to-approach qualifies a named prospect for readiness; this decides what makes a prospect a candidate at all. NEEDS RE-CHECKING against niche-down at write time — this is the weakest distinct_from in the queue and the one most likely to fail honestly.
queue.ledger: NEW ROW — job-not-persona, §7.5, promoted out of Part 7.
queue.risk: Closest call in the cluster. If it cannot be defended against niche-down on the day, it does not get written — the brief's rule, and #137 F2's duplicate-description finding is what that failure looks like in production.
queue.distinct_from_checked: 7 Sep 2026 (#447), against the two named pages, read in full. niche-down's subject is HOW MUCH to narrow and why narrowing the message wins the customers outside it — a size argument — and its axis table recommends the orthogonal cut, one role across industries, which is a WHO. §7.5's finding is that the unit of segmentation is the job the buyer is hiring you for, a WHY, and that a role is a proxy for it. who-to-approach qualifies a named prospect on TIMING (is there a person whose quarter depends on it); the job is what makes a company a candidate before timing is asked. Defended on one condition, kept in the text: the article acknowledges niche-down's table, says why a job is not Cohen's horizontal cut, never re-argues size, and links there for it. No phrase is shared between the two descriptions. Verdict: written. Full reasoning in the studio's ROADMAP.md under #447, 7 Sep.

queue.title: How to prepare for a sales call before you dial
queue.seo_title: How to prepare for a sales call
queue.primary_keyword: how to prepare for a sales call
queue.angle: The preparation that changes a first call is done before it: answer the free test, the named person and who does the work today; make one finished piece of your work on a real case of theirs and send it with the first email; write the agenda in minutes; write the opening, the deciding question and the one ask (no discount) word for word; decide the scale and the pass mark in advance; open the sheet before you dial. Added 8 Oct 2026 by the daily cadence: the queue had nothing queued, and call prep is a named ICP search no article covered. Chosen over 'how to disqualify prospects' (who-to-approach already carries all three disqualification tests as its learnings) and 'how to research a prospect before cold email' (cold-email-personalisation already covers what to read and the paste test).
queue.distinct_from: the-first-call-is-research is what to ask and record DURING the call (one unanswered question, where it goes, the questions that pay, four fields afterwards, reading the log every ten calls); this is what is made and written BEFORE it: the artefact sent ahead, a timed agenda, the opening and the closing ask word for word, the answer scale and the pass mark set in advance. It links there for the questions and the notes rather than repeating them. answer-without-freezing is the AREA shape for an unprepared question mid-call and the bank of real examples built ahead of it; this never covers answering or examples. who-to-approach owns the three tests as list-building learnings; this applies them once to a booked call and only to decide whether it happens and who attends. do-not-delegate-sales names preparation in one sentence (objections, examples, the price) and links here for the method.

queue.title: How to define an ideal customer profile you can build a list from
queue.seo_title: How to define an ideal customer profile
queue.primary_keyword: how to define an ideal customer profile
queue.angle: An ICP has two halves: the firmographic fields a data tool can pre-fill for you to correct, and the half only you hold. Start from two to five real customers (or say there are none, because a made-up example makes a made-up profile), write why they bought as mechanisms, name the role from those reasons, add negative criteria as a standing rule and a list of names, turn it into industry, headcount, geography, keywords and a signal, and read a small segment split one way. Added 9 Oct 2026 by the daily cadence: the queue had nothing queued, and defining an ICP is a named ICP search no article answered as a method. Chosen after passing over 'what to send after a sales call': no studio research file says what to send after a first call or when (the kit's closing ask and a product proposal for asking how a pitch ended are all there is), so that page would have been invented.

queue.title: How to start a B2B newsletter that books sales conversations
queue.seo_title: How to start a B2B newsletter that books calls
queue.primary_keyword: how to start a b2b newsletter
queue.angle: A founder's B2B newsletter is a reason to email the buyers you want to sell to: a feature interview is a request with nothing for sale that strangers answer, and it is a customer conversation as well. Judge it by conversations booked, never subscribers; keep the platform's volume loops and a paid tier off; write the feature request before issue one and send three on day one; one spine format with a word budget per section and a source for every claim, subjects chosen by four tests; weekly for eight issues named in advance, with the stopping rule written down now; sent from a person, with a welcome email that ends on a question. Added 10 Oct 2026 by the daily cadence: the queue had nothing queued. Chosen fourth of four candidates. Passed over: answering 'we already do this in-house' (its research, growth-playbook.md §3.4 Template D, §3.2 Test 2 and 40-conversations.md §4D, is already the in-house-objection and already-staffed rows on who-to-approach, and the capacity reframe, the headwinds quote and 'the reading, not the judgement' are already in four-reasons-businesses-buy and answer-without-freezing, so a page would repeat three articles and promote one finding twice); asking why a deal ended (the-ending-question.html is a product proposal whose evidence is internal usage, and the one general finding, lost to a competitor against no decision, is the lost-to-whom row on who-to-approach); using AI for prospect research (no research file states a reader's method: the material is teardowns of vendors' products and this product's own mechanics, and the general rule, automate the reading and let a person write, is already cold-email-personalisation's third answer).
queue.distinct_from: network-beats-audience argues a network beats an audience, shows the launch numbers, and says to borrow other people's audiences and keep a monthly note going to people you already know; this is how to run your own newsletter whose job is booking conversations with strangers, and it links there for the numbers rather than repeating the argument. the-channel-mix-changed says to start an email list as the relationship platform and to ask how people heard of you; it never says how to run what goes to the list or how to judge it. ads-as-a-positioning-lab tests words with a paid budget; this names the newsletter as the free version in one sentence and links there. the-first-call-is-research is what to ask on a call; this links there for the questions and covers only how the feature interview books the call. No article covers a feature interview as outreach, a newsletter format, a stopping rule for a channel or a welcome email.
